lines.en: : So, let me get this straight — you had a threesome with Imani and Rika, grabbed your pants out of the dryer, and then immediately sprinted over to me.
lines.zh: : 所以,让我理一理——你和 Imani、Rika 玩了三人行,从烘干机里抓起你的裤子,然后立刻冲刺到了我这里。

lines.en: : I’d say it was more of a brisk jog, but yeah. That pretty much sums it up.
lines.zh: : 要我说那更像轻快的慢跑,但没错。基本就是这么回事。

lines.en: : Right, cool. Got it. Can I ask you a question, though?
lines.zh: : 好,酷。明白了。不过我能问你个问题吗?

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I said that being with two attractive women at once is what made me ultimately realize I only have eyes for you?
lines.zh: : 要是我说,正是因为同时和两个有魅力的女人在一起,才让我最终意识到我眼里只有你,你会信吗?

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. If I was like ten years younger and you weren’t already acutely aware that I’m only interested in women. Go home.
lines.zh: : 信啊,当然。前提是我年轻十岁,而且你不是早就清楚地知道我只对女人感兴趣。回家去。

lines.en: : I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我回不去。

lines.en: : Why? Because there’s another girl who wants to sleep with you there? And you must now use my dojo as some sort of sanctuary from sex?
lines.zh: : 为什么?因为那里还有另一个想和你上床的女孩?所以你现在必须把我的道场当作某种躲避性行为的圣所?

lines.en: : Well, when you put it that way, I am more safe here. You can be my bodyguard.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你这么说的话,我在这儿确实更安全。你可以当我的保镖。

lines.en: : And no, I am not ashamed to say that as I am a good guy who can formally acknowledge that sometimes girls are stronger than boys. Praise me for my political correctness.
lines.zh: : 而且不,我不羞于说这话,因为我是个好人,能郑重承认有时候女孩就是比男孩强壮。请为我的政治正确表扬我。

lines.en: : Weren’t you trying to find some sort of heterosexual loophole to finger me less than twenty four hours ago?
lines.zh: : 不到二十四小时之前,你不是还在试图找某种异性恋漏洞来抠我吗?

lines.en: : I’d say I was just trying to learn more about your ways of life.
lines.zh: : 要我说,我只是想更了解你们的生活方式。

lines.en: : Just leave! I don’t want to tell you any more about my ways of life!
lines.zh: : 滚出去!我不想再听你聊任何关于我生活方式的事!

lines.en: : I just don’t really know what I’m supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 我只是真的不知道自己该怎么办。

lines.en: : I just told you what you’re supposed to do!
lines.zh: : 我刚刚不是告诉你该怎么办了吗!

lines.en: : No, about what they were trying to get out of me at the bar last night.
lines.zh: : 不,是关于她们昨晚在酒吧想从我这里套出的事。

lines.en: : Oh, are we being serious again? It’s hard to pick up your tone sometimes with you always muttering everything.
lines.zh: : 哦,我们又切换到认真模式了?你这家伙总是把每句话都嘟囔出口,有时候真难捕捉你的语气。

lines.en: : Do you think it’s safe to, like...tell them? Or maybe just Imani at least?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,像……告诉她们,安全吗?或者至少,只告诉 Imani?

lines.en: : Do I think it’s safe for you to tell the teacher of a group of young girls that you are actively having sex with like half of them? No, Akira. I don’t think that is safe. For I am not an idiot.
lines.zh: : 你觉得,把你正和她们里差不多一半的人持续做爱这件事,告诉一位一群年轻女孩的老师,安全吗?不,Akira。我不觉得那安全。因为我不是白痴。

lines.en: : But...this is Imani we’re talking about. And you guys are like peanut butter and chocolate, so I’m sure she’d probably figure out some way to justify it and not disown you.
lines.zh: : 可是……我们说的是 Imani。你们俩就像花生酱和巧克力,所以我敢肯定她会想出办法把这事儿合理化,不会跟你断绝关系的。

lines.en: : Which one of us is peanut butter and which one of us is chocolate?
lines.zh: : 我们俩谁是花生酱,谁是巧克力?

lines.en: : What does that look imply? I am too politically correct to understand.
lines.zh: : 你那个表情是什么意思?我政治正确得太彻底,理解不了。

lines.en: : Akira, I can’t tell you whether or not it’s a good idea to burden anyone else with the information you have bestowed unto me. So if that’s the advice you’re looking for, scram. I can’t help.
lines.zh: : Akira,你要不要再把这个情报去压给别人,这主意好不好,我给不了你答案。所以如果你要找的是这种建议,滚吧。我帮不了。

lines.en: : It’s honestly miraculous those two haven’t already figured it out. Especially with what Rika’s daughter’s apparently been texting you.
lines.zh: : 说真的,那两位到现在还没察觉出来,简直是奇迹。尤其是考虑到 Rika 的女儿 apparently 一直在给你发短信这件事。

lines.en: : I mean, they kind of have. They just don’t have any sort of smoking gun to prove it yet and I’m like one step away from just handing it to them so they can shoot me.
lines.zh: : 我是说,她们差不多已经察觉了。只是还没有任何铁证,而我离亲手把铁证递过去、好让她们毙了我,只差一步。

lines.en: : And do you want to get shot?
lines.zh: : 那你想被毙吗?

lines.en: : Metaphorically. Do not use this opportunity to joke about killing yourself again.
lines.zh: : 打个比方。别趁机又拿自杀开玩笑。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Sometimes, I don’t. Sometimes I do. And that question alone has been compelling me to do a lot of really stupid shit lately.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。有时候,不想。有时候,想。光是这个问题本身,最近就逼着我干了一堆蠢到家的事。

lines.en: : You mean like fucking your girlfriend’s little sister while you’re all on a trip together and then just hoping they don’t find you?
lines.zh: : 你是说,比如趁大家一起旅行时上了你女朋友的妹妹,然后就盼着她们别找到你?

lines.en: : That’s a very specific example, Osako. Are you speaking from experience? Does Wakana have a little sister I don’t know about?
lines.zh: : 这个例子可真具体,Osako。你在讲亲身经历?Wakana 有个我不知道的妹妹?

lines.en: : No, you fucking moron! I’m talking about your fucking idol ex-girlfriend and how she caught you screwing her fucking sister! Come on!
lines.zh: : 不,你这个该死的白痴!我说的是你那个该死的偶像前女友,以及她怎么抓到你上她那个该死的妹妹的!拜托!

lines.en: : Wha- but how do you know about that?
lines.zh: : 什——可你是怎么知道那件事的?

lines.en: : Because I went to a bar!
lines.zh: : 因为我去了酒吧!

lines.en: : And the whole bar was talking about it?
lines.zh: : 然后全酒吧的人都在议论?

lines.en: : No, she was! Niki!
lines.zh: : 不,是她说的!Niki!

lines.en: : To the whole bar?
lines.zh: : 对着全酒吧?

lines.en: : Akira, I’m going to kill you one day.
lines.zh: : Akira,总有一天我会杀了你。

lines.en: : What, just to you then? What sort of coincidence is that? You guys don’t even know each other, right?
lines.zh: : 什么,只对她一个人说?那算什么巧合?你们俩根本不认识,对吧?

lines.en: : We do now. So much so that we created a new martial art just to get back at you.
lines.zh: : 现在认识了。认识到我们专门为你发明了一门新武术的程度。

lines.en: : How...was she doing? Apart from just being mad at me, which is perfectly reasonable.
lines.zh: : 她……她过得怎么样?除了生我的气之外——那完全合理。

lines.en: : Uhh...about as good as one could expect to be after finding out their boyfriend was boning their teenage sister?
lines.zh: : 呃……大概就是一个发现男朋友在睡自己十几岁妹妹的人,所能预期的最好状态吧?

lines.en: : So...bad?
lines.zh: : 所以……很糟?

lines.en: : Yes, Akira. Bad. That is not a thing normal people do. So when normal-ish people like Niki Nakayama bear witness to it, they become emotional. This is called “being a human.”
lines.zh: : 对,Akira。很糟。正常人干不出那种事。所以当 Niki Nakayama 这种比较正常的人亲眼目睹它时,她们会情绪激动。这叫「身为人类」。

lines.en: : Okay, Osako. I feel bad enough about what happened. I don’t need the sarcasm.
lines.zh: : 好了,Osako。对发生的事我已经够难受了。我不需要讽刺。

lines.en: : Do you feel bad, Akira? Or are you only just saying that because you were caught?
lines.zh: : 你真的难受吗,Akira?还是只因为你被抓住了,才这么说?

lines.en: : No, see, I wanted to get caught. That’s how much I love her.
lines.zh: : 不,你听我说,我是故意想被抓的。我有多爱她,由此可见。

lines.en: : Was that a joke? What was the punchline?
lines.zh: : 那是个笑话吗?笑点在哪里?

lines.en: : Hah...It wasn’t a joke. She’s just given up her entire life for me since we were kids and she’s going to keep doing that so long as I’m in the picture.
lines.zh: : 哈……那不是笑话。她从我们还是孩子的时候起,就把她整个人生都给了我,而只要我还在她的世界里,她就会继续这么给下去。

lines.en: : Just look at how much she was able to accomplish the first time we split up. She became a world famous idol. That’s what she’s capable of without me.
lines.zh: : 你只要看看我们第一次分开时,她做到了多少事。她成了世界闻名的偶像。那就是没有我的她能做到的事。

lines.en: : Listen, I’m not going to stand here and pretend to know what sort of weird, fucked up relationship you guys have. But if you saw her now, you might be rethinking that, Akira.
lines.zh: : 听着,我不会站在这儿假装自己懂你们那种怪异又扭曲的关系是什么样。但你要是现在见到她,说不定会重新掂量那句话,Akira。

lines.en: : What does it matter how much a person can accomplish if they’re miserable while doing it?
lines.zh: : 如果一个人在做事的时候痛苦不堪,那她能做到多少事,又有什么要紧?

lines.en: : On an individual level, not much. But think of how much good she’s doing for the people out there who need her. The ones she inspires and motivates. Who revere her work and look up to her.
lines.zh: : 对个人而言,没什么要紧。但想想她正在为外面那些需要她的人做多少好事。那些受她鼓舞、被她激励的人。那些崇敬她的作品、仰望她的人。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m thinking about them. Now what? Do we just sacrifice her feelings in exchange for theirs? Does that make this okay?
lines.zh: : 好。我在想他们了。然后呢?我们就这样牺牲她的感受去换他们的?那这件事就算正当了吗?

lines.en: : None of it’s okay. It sucks. All of it sucks. And I’m the one who is perpetuating this suckiness because I can’t bring myself to change and just keep pulling more people under with me.
lines.zh: : 没有一样是正当的。烂透了。全都烂透了。而让这份烂持续下去的人正是我,因为我没法让自己改变,只能继续把更多人一起拖下水。

lines.en: : And now you think Imani and Rika will be the next to drown.
lines.zh: : 而现在你觉得,下一个溺水的会是 Imani 和 Rika。

lines.en: : Right. And while the answer of “don’t drown them” is most certainly the correct one, I keep telling myself it’s not. So I need you to slap some sense into-
lines.zh: : 没错。虽然「别拖她们下水」这个答案肯定是对的,我却一直对自己说它不对。所以我需要你扇我几巴掌,把我扇醒——

lines.en: : Did that help?
lines.zh: : 这下有帮助吗?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Okay. Let me try again.
lines.zh: : 好。那我再试一次。

lines.en: : Please don’t. Just tell me I’m an idiot and remind me of how much of a shitty situation I put you in by telling you.
lines.zh: : 请别。你就直接告诉我我是个白痴,再提醒我一下,我告诉你这些,给你添了个多烂的摊子。

lines.en: : Do I not do that enough already? I feel like I remind you a lot.
lines.zh: : 我平时做得还不够多吗?我感觉我已经提醒过你很多次了。

lines.en: : You do. My mind just can’t comprehend receiving what it wants. So even when my desires are satisfied, there’s still some sort of ingrained desire to keep going after them.
lines.zh: : 你是够多了。只是我的大脑没法理解「得到想要的东西」这种事。所以哪怕欲望被满足了,身体里还是残留着某种根深蒂固的渴望,要继续追着它们跑。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure they call that “addiction” in the real world.
lines.zh: : 我相当确定,在现实世界里,人们管这叫「成瘾」。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, the real world sounds pretty nice right about now.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这么说来,现实世界现在听起来还挺美的。

lines.en: : Then fucking come back down to it, asshole.
lines.zh: : 那就他妈的滚回现实里来啊,混蛋。

lines.en: : Easier said than done, Osako.
lines.zh: : 说起来容易做起来难,Osako。

lines.en: : Easier said than done...
lines.zh: : 说起来容易做起来难……

lines.en: : Stop acting like some kind of drama protagonist by meekly repeating lines like that and just fucking do it, man.
lines.zh: : 别再像某种偶像剧主角一样,软绵绵地复述这种台词,直接他妈的去做啊,伙计。

lines.en: : You’re your own worst enemy here. And it’s starting to rub off on others too. Even Ayane’s been fucking miserable lately and that girl’s always been a ray of sunshine.
lines.zh: : 你最大的敌人就是你自己。而且这毛病开始传染给别人了。连 Ayane 最近都他妈惨兮兮的,那个女孩以前可一直是一束阳光。

lines.en: : How so? What’s she doing? Is she-
lines.zh: : 怎么回事?她怎么了?她是不是——

lines.en: : Outside. I just realized you’re not going away and I don’t want to be stuck here for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : 去外面说。我刚意识到你是不会走的了,而我不想今天剩下的时间都被你钉在这儿。

lines.en: : So she’s just barely showing up now? And when she does, she seems out of it?
lines.zh: : 所以她现在只是勉强露个面?而且露面的时候,看起来魂不守舍?

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s a good way to sum it up without having to waste like ten paragraphs on it. So did something, like...happen or?...
lines.zh: : 对,不用浪费十段话就能这么概括,总结得不错。那么,是不是出了什么事,像是……出事了还是?……

lines.en: : Uhh...a lot has happened. It’s just kind of difficult saying what since we sort of...don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 呃……发生了很多事。只是不太说得清是什么,因为我们算是……真的不知道。

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is, that’s the same look I’ve been getting from her. And on you, it works. Fits you as a person better. It’s weird for Ayane, though. So I humbly ask you to make it stop.
lines.zh: : 好吧,不管那是什么,她看我的也是同一种眼神。放在你身上,很合适。更适合你这个人。但放在 Ayane 身上就很怪。所以我谦卑地请求你,让它停下。

lines.en: : I would if I could. But just like how it is with Niki, the more involved I get, the more painful I think it will be for her.
lines.zh: : 我能停早就停了。但就像 Niki 那件事一样,我陷得越深,我想她日后只会越痛。

lines.en: : Ayane doesn’t normally talk about what’s bothering her. She’s the type to just hide it until she breaks into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : Ayane 平时不会说自己被什么困扰。她是那种把一切藏起来、直到碎成一百万片的人。

lines.en: : I know. Which is why this time is weird. Because either she’s given up on hiding it, or it’s just so powerful that she can’t.
lines.zh: : 我知道。所以这次才这么反常。要么是她放弃了隐瞒,要么是那东西太汹涌,她藏不住了。

lines.en: : Either way, that’s something you’re more suited to deal with than me.
lines.zh: : 无论是哪种,那都是你比我更适合去处理的事。

lines.en: : I don’t know if that’s true, Osako. You probably play a bigger role in her life than I think you really understand.
lines.zh: : 我不确定是不是这样,Osako。你在她人生里扮演的角色,可能比你自以为理解的重要得多。

lines.en: : What? How?
lines.zh: : 什么?怎么说?

lines.en: : Well, she doesn’t have a mom. And the closest thing she does have to one already belongs to someone else, so she likely feels like a burden talking to her about anything.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛,她没有妈妈。而她身边最接近妈妈角色的那个人,已经名花有主了,所以跟那位谈任何事,她多半都觉得自己是个负担。

lines.en: : Okay. And?
lines.zh: : 好。然后呢?

lines.en: : And you’re a cool, older woman who knows her and teaches her about things.
lines.zh: : 然后你就是一位又酷、又年长的女性,认识她,还教她各种东西。

lines.en: : I teach her self-defense. That’s not even remotely similar to motherhood.
lines.zh: : 我教她的是防身术。那和母职半点都不沾边。

lines.en: : I mean...it kind of is, isn’t it? Just in the physical department instead of the mental one. I bet Ayane would be really happy if you tried getting closer to her.
lines.zh: : 我是说……多少沾一点,不是吗?只不过在身体那一科,而不是心理那一科。我敢说,如果你试着和她走近一点,Ayane 会非常高兴。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t buy it. I’m just her teacher at the end of the day. And I imagine that’s all she sees me as too.
lines.zh: : 呃,我不买账。说到底我只是她的老师。我也想象得出,她看我也只有这一层。

lines.en: : I mean, I am also her teacher. And I sleep with her.
lines.zh: : 我是说,我也是她的老师啊。而我和她睡。

lines.en: : Cool, yeah. I’ll put sleeping with Ayane on my to-do list then. I’m sure that will magically cure all of her problems and definitely won’t just cause more damage in the long run.
lines.zh: : 酷,好。那我把「和 Ayane 睡」加进我的待办清单。我确信那会神奇地治好她所有的问题,而且长远来看绝对不会再造成更多伤害。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t hurt to try, would it?
lines.zh: : 试试又不会掉块肉,对吧?

lines.en: : Sleeping with a high-schooler?! How did you manage to pivot from guilt to propaganda in less than thirty minutes?!
lines.zh: : 和一个高中生上床?!你是怎么在不到三十分钟里,从内疚一百八十度转向传销的?!

lines.en: : No, obviously not sleeping with her. Just...being the cool older woman she can talk to about stuff. Stuff she won’t tell me because she knows how I am.
lines.zh: : 不,当然不是和她睡。只是……当一个她又酷、又年长,什么都能聊的女性。那些她不会告诉我的事——因为她知道我是什么德行。

lines.en: : How would that even work, though?
lines.zh: : 可那要怎么实现?

lines.en: : I really only see her during lessons. And every time I’ve tried to pull her aside to ask if everything’s okay, she just says she’s fine and that she needs to go do her homework.
lines.zh: : 我真的只在上课时见到她。而每次我试着把她拉到一边,问问一切是否还好,她都只会说她挺好的,然后说她得回去写作业了。

lines.en: : Oh, easy. Just corner her.
lines.zh: : 哦,简单。堵住她就行。

lines.en: : A statement that threatening requires a little more hesitation, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 这么有威胁性的发言,是不是应该再多犹豫一秒?

lines.en: : Sure, but we’ve already discerned that I don’t operate on the same level as regular people. I’m the guy you come to for unconventional advice.
lines.zh: : 当然,但我们不是已经确认过了吗,我和普通人不在一个层面上运转。我可是你遇到非常规问题时来取经的那个人。

lines.en: : Didn’t you come to me? How’d this devolve into a crash course on the steps I should take to look out for a girl who only loosely appreciates my existence?
lines.zh: : 到底是谁来找谁?这怎么就演变成一门速成课,教我该按什么步骤去照顾一个对我的存在只有稀薄感激的女孩?

lines.en: : That’s easy, too. You’re emotionally vulnerable and I have a precedented pattern of utilizing such things to distract from my inadequacies, capitalizing on weakness for personal gain.
lines.zh: : 这也很好解释。你情感脆弱,而我有前例可循的模式,就是利用这种东西来转移我自己的无能,把别人的弱点变现成个人利益。

lines.en: : You really are the product of her existence, aren’t you? The fucking abuse-poet lady. Because she was doing the same thing to you. Using you for her own personal gain.
lines.zh: : 你还真是一模一样的「她存在的产物」,对吧?那个该死的施虐女诗人。因为她当年对你做的,也是同样的事。为了她自己的利益利用你。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean she didn’t love me.
lines.zh: : 但那不代表她不爱我。

lines.en: : Akira...come on.
lines.zh: : Akira……拜托。

lines.en: : What? Do you think I don’t love Ayane? That that’s what I’m doing with her?
lines.zh: : 什么?你觉得我不爱 Ayane?觉得我对她做的就是那种事?

lines.en: : Stop asking me to interpret all these fucked up relationships and just realize that I’m normal. Of course I’m not going to understand the perspective of someone who went through this.
lines.zh: : 别再让我来解读你们这些扭曲的关系了,认清一个事实吧——我是个正常人。我当然理解不了一个经历过那些的人的视角。

lines.en: : I just think that there’s a lot more...complexity regarding relationships that extend through different age groups than you do.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得,跨越年龄层的关系,其中的……复杂程度,比你以为的深得多。

lines.en: : And that, if I am going to talk to Ayane, that I probably shouldn’t be taking advice from a guy who’d just whip his dick out and try to cure her with that.
lines.zh: : 还有,如果我真的要去找 Ayane 谈,我大概也不该听从一个家伙的建议——那种家伙只会当场掏出老二,试图用那玩意儿治好她。

lines.en: : You’ll actually do it then?
lines.zh: : 那你真的会去做了?

lines.en: : I don’t know...it still feels kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……感觉还是有点怪。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m really cut out for, like...motherly stuff if that’s the role I’m supposed to be filling right now. And I imagine she’d feel the same way.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我真的适合那种……母性的东西,如果那是我现在该扮演的角色的话。我想她也会有同感。

lines.en: : I think you’d be a good mom, Osako.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你会是个好妈妈,Osako。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you know all about proper parenthood, Boy.
lines.zh: : 是嘛,毕竟你对「合格的为人父母」无所不知,小子。

lines.en: : Maybe I don’t, but...
lines.zh: : 也许我并不懂,但是……

lines.en: : I feel like I do...
lines.zh: : 我感觉我懂……

lines.en: : And I feel like I’m overstepping and will just make her uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 而我感觉我这是越界,只会让她不自在。

lines.en: : Only one way to find out.
lines.zh: : 只有一种办法能知道了。

lines.en: : If you’re uncomfortable with it, though-
lines.zh: : 不过,如果你觉得不自在的话——

lines.en: : That’s not it. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 不是因为那个。只是……

lines.en: : Sometimes, you spend so much time telling yourself what you are and what you’ll do with your life that anything outside of that vision seems sort of...I don’t know. Impossible? Foreign, maybe?
lines.zh: : 有时候,你花了太多时间告诉自己「你是什么」「你这一生要做什么」,以至于那个图景之外的任何东西,都显得有点……怎么说呢。不可能?陌生,也许?

lines.en: : Yeah...I think I get what you mean.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我想我懂你的意思。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe I will. Maybe I won’t. I just hope she gets better soon.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许我会去。也许不会。我只是希望她快点好起来。

lines.en: : And I hope you figure out a way to confront your issues with other adults instead of leeching off of my lesbian wisdom all the time.
lines.zh: : 而我希望你找出一个办法,去和别的成年人直面你的问题,而不是一直趴在我的蕾丝边智慧上吸血。

lines.en: : It is not my fault that lesbians are so wise. Do you blame Harry Potter for going to Gandalf for advice in Star Wars?
lines.zh: : 蕾丝边们如此智慧,这可不是我的错。你会责怪 Harry Potter 在《星球大战》里去找 Gandalf 要建议吗?

lines.en: : You have no idea what you just said, do you?
lines.zh: : 你完全不知道自己刚说了什么,对吧?

lines.en: : I say a lot of things, Osako. I can’t be expected to know all of them.
lines.zh: : 我说的话很多,Osako。你不能指望我全都记得。

lines.en: : Seriously. Just go home.
lines.zh: : 认真的。回家去。

lines.en: I accompany Osako back to her apartment (against her will) and spend the rest of the trek home deciding what I want to do with Imani and Rika.
lines.zh: 我护送 Osako 回她的公寓(违背她的意愿),并在回家路上一路盘算,我到底想拿 Imani 和 Rika 怎么办。

lines.en: Besides having more sex with them, I mean.
lines.zh: 除了和她们多做一些爱之外,我是说。

lines.en: And what I land on is this-
lines.zh: 而我最终得出的结论是——

lines.en: No matter what happens, it can only be good.
lines.zh: 无论发生什么,结局只可能是好的。

lines.en: For I want to be caught, but I don’t.
lines.zh: 因为我渴望被抓住,但我又不渴望。

lines.en: And I want to be loved, but I don’t.
lines.zh: 我渴望被爱,但我又不渴望。

lines.en: I want to be fixed.
lines.zh: 我想被修好。

lines.en: I don’t.
lines.zh: 我不想。
